name: Wash trading, airdrop and Sybil / multi-account farming (flagged: prohibited; detector and defence specification)
one_line: Manufactured volume and wallet clusters aimed at a hoped-for POLY token, tiers, leaderboards, builder rewards or third-party points; ~25% of historical share volume when trading was free, ~0.02-1% now with same-wallet matches blocked, fee-negative, prohibited, and never paid; written as the anti-Sybil detector spec.
maturity: Established practice, unrealised payoff; prevalence measured (Columbia 25% of historical share volume, Dubach 0.97% median Feb-Mar 2026, own live two-wallet round trips 0.015% pooled with same-wallet matches blocked by the engine since 2023), no token announced, fee-bearing loops negative-sum by construction
requires_ai: optional; classical graph and ratio detectors, LLM only for cluster triage
edge: None; an option on issuer generosity that fees now price negative
capital: none for the detector (<$1k infra); farming consumes capital at 1-3.5c per $ of notional
build_time: 2-4 weeks solo for the detector on an existing indexer
opportunity_size: $0 realised token payoff; $13.4k of Sybil-captured LP rewards documented; ~$4.5B historical wash volume; shrinking
expected_results: Farming: derived net -1.0 to -3.4c per $ volume vs 0.2-4.5c hypothetical payout; detector reproduces published shares
competition: 100+-wallet farmers, industrial Sybil funders, points intermediaries, the venue's ML surveillance
flag: prohibited: ToS §4.2 wash / beneficial-ownership clause, programme clawbacks, US Rule 7.2, CEA §4c(a)
validate: Replay OrderFilled on 600 markets, funder-graph recall on the 24,539-wallet cluster, weekly clustering vs Columbia curve; <$300
top_risk: Own multi-wallet stack self-matches and forfeits rewards under the same clause
solo_fit_reason: As income it is prohibited and negative expected value; as a detector it is a cheap two-to-four-week build whose only value is cleaner inputs for the owner's LP, copy-trading and flow files and self-match prevention on the owner's own wallets.
speed_class: speed-insensitive: batch detection; only log retention is time-bound
results_10k: no; -$8,500 to -$10,000/month; Obsidian climb nets -$150k to -$280k (derived)
min_capital: $0 to farm (do not); ~$300 one-off plus $30-150/month for the detector
capacity_ceiling: the farm's own fee bill; fee-free geopolitics earns no wV or rebates
services: CTF Exchange V2 and NegRisk adapter events
Polymarket programme docs (fees, rebates, referral, builders)
changes_made: Written 2026-09-28 with live checks: Data API paired-fill tape on 12 active markets (48,756 rows, $8.11M one-sided notional; self-match 0.093% pooled, round trips 0.015%, max 0.445%), Gamma volume24hr reconciliation (1.96-2.11x one-sided notional in 10 of 12 markets), all-time volume leaderboard and /v2/user-stats fingerprints for six nine-figure wallets (four with 31-246 shares per USDC dollar at $0.002-0.017 average prices, 98-99.8% maker), builder leaderboard (2-3-user builders with $15M-$142M attributed), help-centre token page (2026-06-24), taker-rebate, maker-rebate, fee, referral and builder-fee docs, transparency and integrity pages.

Critic notes addressed: maturity set to 'Established practice, unrealised payoff'; file framed as a detector / defence specification with a validation harness; rival-venue points farming hedged on Polymarket added as sub-variant (6) with Opinion's $10B volume / $31M OI and the $45 to ~$6 points collapse (PANews; the 86% in E5 is 87% derived from the article's figures).

Fee arithmetic derived from the docs: fee per unit of taker-tier weighted volume is feeRate / category weight independent of price (2.9-5.0c per $ wV); the climb to Obsidian costs $294k-$500k gross, recovers ~38% via tier rebates plus $34,310 of bonuses, net -$150k to -$280k.
Sources 23-24 (March 2026 integrity rules release and Cointelegraph) cited in Cons / risks after the checker flagged them as uncited.

Cite-check + skeptic pass 2026-09-28 (29 numbered sources re-fetched, 27 reachable, SSRN and The Block 403 to curl, The Block confirmed via WebFetch; own tape re-analysed and partly re-run): the Columbia paper was obtained from a mirror and read in full, added as [30] and made the primary cite for the 25% / 60% / 45% / 17% / 14% figures, which are share-volume measures (sample 2022-11-21 to 2025-10-12, $15.5B, 1.33M wallets; TenChar 43,011 wallets and Lander 109,142 wallets clusters); the paper states same-wallet trading has been blocked since 2023-04-27 and the writer's 'self-matches still execute (0.03-0.45%)' claim was withdrawn: all 131 cases were one wallet's YES and NO quotes filled by the same taker (cross-asset), same-asset self-matches are $0, so the live residue is the two-wallet round-trip share 0.015% pooled (max 0.27%); the 'volume24hr = 1.96-2.11x one-sided notional' claim did not reproduce and was replaced by a live 24 h reconciliation on four markets (volume24hr = sum of all fill rows within 3% in three of four; 1.02-2.27x paired one-sided notional), and the 'divide by two' advice became 'pair the fills'; Data API 403 narrowed to Python's default urllib user agent (curl's default passes); Decrypt's $4.5B labelled as the outlet's conversion; Opinion points drop stated as ~87% derived with the article's 'over 80%'; realized_pnl read gap corrected to 34 minutes; underestimating points 1, 2, 4 and 10 rewritten accordingly; 'can be gamed with sub-penny fills' softened to a detector observation.
open_doubts: The Columbia headline is a share-volume measure; the paper does not report the wash share of dollar volume, so '25% of volume' overstates the dollar share by an unknown factor (its wash clusters traded at tenths of a penny).

Own live round-trip test covers 12 markets, four capped at 8,000 rows; the volume reconciliation was re-measured on only four markets, and one (a neg-risk tweet bucket) shows Gamma volume 1.9x the tape with no explanation found.

The 2023-04-27 self-trade block is stated in the Columbia paper without a primary Polymarket source; E1 found no documentation of it, and the live tape can only show that no same-wallet match occurred in 48,756 rows.
The cause of 2-3-user builders with nine-figure attributed volume (self-attribution versus omnibus integrations) is inferred; Jupiter is known to be omnibus.
The dust-price share-volume wallets are labelled as leaderboard inflation by pattern; whether the motive is status farming or a by-product of tail selling is not observable.
Token break-even uses community FDV and allocation guesses (E2) and Akey's $67B lifetime volume; any Sybil filter makes the payoff zero, so the range is an upper bound.
No published count of wallets banned or rewards clawed back exists; the April 2026 ghost-transaction bans are reported second-hand without numbers.
Kalshi's reported allegation of ~70% wash volume in top Polymarket markets (MSN headline in the brief) was not read and is omitted.
